source: Fonseca et al. 2024, Journal of Systematic Palaeontology 22: 2346577, Fig. 2: strict consensus of early dinosaurs and ornithischians, in two columns (the Cerapoda branch continues from the left column to the right by a heavy connector line); rectangular, root left, hairline branches, small bold clade names at nodes, numbered black dots keyed to a legend (1-12), bootstrap values, shaded boxes with large clade names and silhouettes. Image: census figure (2045x1577 px).

names_note: the paper's matrix taxa (census list, 172; Lutungutali sitwensis and Pareisactus evrostos are not in the figure). Seven printed spellings take the list spelling: Emausaurus ernsti -> ernstii, Stegourus -> Stegouros, Micropachycephalosaurus hongtuyanensis -> 'Micropachycephalosaurus h' (truncated in the list), Transylvanosaurus platycephalus -> platycephals, Quantasaurus -> Qantassaurus, Uetodon -> Uteodon, Mantellisaurus atherfiledensis -> atherfieldensis
gold_note: Early dinosaur and ornithischian strict consensus, two columns joined by a connector. Internal labels: the bold node names (Pan-Aves, Pterosauromorpha, Dinosauromorpha, Dinosauria, Eusaurischia, Ornithischia, Parapredentata, Saphornithischia, Heterodontosaurinae, Genasauria, Thyreophoroidea, Eurypoda, Ankylosauria, Euankylosauria, Neornithischia, Pyrodontia, Thescelosaurinae, Marginocephalia, Euceratopsia, Hypsilophodontidae, Ornithopoda, Iguanodontia, Euiguanodontia, Dryomorpha, Styacosterna, as printed) and the legend names of numbered dots 1-12 (Lagerpetidae, Sauropodomorpha, Theropoda, Stegosauria, Parankylosauria, Orodrominae, Chaoyangsauridae, Pachycephalosauridae, Tenontosauridae, Rhabdodontoidea, Rhabdodontidae, Camptosauridae). The large names on the shaded boxes (Saurischia, Thyreophora, Ceratopsia, etc.) are not encoded. Read by eye from 2-4x crops: the hairline branches break where clade names sit across them, so the pixel listing could not be used. 170 tips, 7 polytomies (6, 6, 5, 3, 12, 7, 3 children); 37 printed clade names kept as internal node labels. Random-sample case (seed 20261114). Topology transcribed from the figure image and checked node by node; topology only.
